items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: Ralph Watkins and Irving Alexander, I believe, and Monte Kay. Monte Kay, they had this.

ctx.x: you never thought I'd make it, did you. I said, I never doubted that you'd make it, Harry. He said, Buddy, here I am.

But any way -- the Royal Roost was quite a place, you know, quite a club. Ralph Watkins and Irving Alexander, I believe, and Monte Kay. Monte Kay, they had this. And this particular band as I said was like an all star band. But everybody in there was junkies. You know, I guess Cecil Paine and -- well, just a lot of the guys I won't name. You know, some of them have beat it now so this is why I won't --
